Diagnostics

    Last inspection fused verdict of the 5-camera tunnel

    Waiting for the first carton at PE-201.

    Cameras untick to exclude a camera from the decision

    Coverage why one camera is not enough

    Accept / reject rules

    1. Trigger. The leading edge of a carton breaks PE-201 → the PLC assigns a tracking ID and all five cameras capture at once.
    2. Find the carton. Pixels with cardboard colour (hue 15–50°, saturation > 0.28) are the carton; belt, frame and background are ignored.
    3. Look for defects inside the carton outline: red pixels (hue < 14° or > 340°) = wrong label; blue pixels (hue 190–265°) = ink contamination.
    4. Per camera: DEFECT if defect pixels > 5 % of the carton area · NO_READ if the image is dark (camera fault) or the carton covers < 3 % of it · otherwise GOOD.
    5. Fusion: any camera DEFECT → reject · any camera NO_READ → reject (fail-safe) · all cameras GOOD → accept.
    6. Action: the verdict is stored against the tracking ID. At PE-301 the PLC fires pusher YV-301 for anything that is not GOOD, including cartons whose verdict did not arrive in time.

    The bottom face is not inspected: that would need a camera under a gap between two belts (future scope).
